newsitem.title: USA: Holder to sell 13.0 mln WellPoint shares.
newsitem.headline: Holder to sell 13.0 mln WellPoint shares.

text.p: WellPoint Health Networks Inc on Friday filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a secondary offering for up to 13.0 million common shares.

The shares will be offered by California HealthCare Foundation, a shareholder which currently holds an 80.3 percent stake in WellPoint. When the offering is complete, the foundation will reduce its stake to about 60.7 percent, or 40.36 million common shares.
The offering will be made through an underwriters' group that includes Merrill Lynch & Co, Salomon Brothers, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co.
WellPoint has given the underwriters an overallotment option for up to 1.95 million additional common shares.

Based in Woodland Hills, Calif., WellPoint is one of the nation's largest publicly traded management health care companies with about 4.2 million medical members, 11.9 million pharmacy members and 1.5 million dental members as of June 30.
